# Appify - All-in-one iOS App Platform
> 8 privacy-first iOS productivity apps: Work Hours Tracker, Image to PDF, Image Converter, Money Tracker, CleanPhoto, Translate - Offline Translator, Paper Scan, Extract Audio Now. Files and videos are processed on your device.

## Apps
- [Work Hours Tracker](https://appify.show/en/work-hours-tracker/): Best work hours tracker app for iOS. Clock in/out with one tap, calculate hourly wages and overtime automatically. Built-in labor law presets for 13 countries/regions plus custom rules.
- [Image to PDF](https://appify.show/en/image-to-pdf/): Mobile PDF toolkit. Convert images to PDF, stitch photos, PDF to images, merge, encrypt and decrypt — all processed locally on your device, files never leave your phone.
- [Image Converter](https://appify.show/en/image-converter/): Mobile image toolkit. Convert between JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP and TIFF; compress, crop, rotate, resize, stitch photos into long screenshots or grids. All processed locally on your device.
- [Money Tracker](https://appify.show/en/money-tracker/): A beautiful, privacy-first expense and income tracking app
- [CleanPhoto](https://appify.show/en/cleanphoto/): Smart Photo Cleaner for iOS. Free up space by removing similar photos, screenshots, and blurry images.
- [Translate - Offline Translator](https://appify.show/en/translate-offline-translator/): Offline photo translator for iOS. Snap a picture, extract text with on-device OCR, and translate it instantly. Works without internet after model setup.
- [Paper Scan](https://appify.show/en/paperscan/): Pro document scanner for iOS. Ultra-wide capture, six GPU filters, on-device OCR, multi-page PDF export, and conflict-free Google Drive / iCloud sync. Offline by default.
- [Extract Audio Now](https://appify.show/en/extract-audio-now/): Extract audio from any video on iPhone. Pull MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, FLAC or OGG in seconds, plus 7 video tools (convert, compress, merge, clip, speed, adjust, GIF). Fully on-device, no upload.

## Developer
- Appify

## Key Facts
- 8 free iOS apps across work, finance, media, and productivity
- Extract Audio Now: free with ads, Pro subscription removes ads (all features included in free)
- Image, PDF, video, and audio processing happens on device — files never leave the phone
- Translate - Offline Translator works without internet after a one-time model download
- Paper Scan is offline by default, with optional Google Drive / iCloud sync
- Website available in 15 languages
- Built-in labor law presets for 13 countries/regions (Work Hours Tracker)
